name: manual_857bba
claim: When replacing a contaminated or noisy PR branch, preserve the old PR final tree as the first clean replay commit; add later memory or audit notes as separate follow-up commits only after proving the replacement diff matches the saved old PR snapshot.

decisions.notes: PR258 showed that bundling a later memory/surgery note into the first replacement replay makes the old-vs-new content comparison ambiguous. The cleaner maneuver is exact-tree replay first, then optional memory-only follow-up.

rationale: PR258 showed that bundling a later memory/surgery note into the first replacement replay makes the old-vs-new content comparison ambiguous. The cleaner maneuver is exact-tree replay first, then optional memory-only follow-up.
